summary: Learn to design surveys, assess samples and report market evidence. Explore this five-day market research training and plan your next step.
lede: Market research training helps analysts, marketing professionals and customer-insight teams turn business questions into evidence for decisions. Participants practise defining research briefs, choosing sampling approaches and improving questionnaires to investigate customer or market questions. They also review survey data, interpret qualitative themes, outline market size and present findings with clear assumptions and practical implications.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for professionals who collect, commission, analyze or use customer and market evidence in day-to-day decisions.
modules: Market Sizing with TAM SAM SOM
prerequisites: Prior professional market-research experience is not required. Basic computer and spreadsheet familiarity will help with the Excel exercises. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted synthesis are introduced at a conceptual awareness level; the course does not train you to build or deploy models.
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
